rules.text: Use PMB as the sole test drug; do not substitute colistin or other antibiotics, or import the apramycin model or its parameters.

evidence.quote: PMB is the sole test drug; colistin and other antibiotics are not substitutes.
Following the translational objective of Sou et al. (2021), we do not import the apramycin model or its parameters.

rules.text: Use PMB_source_tables_by_species.xlsx as the single animal and in-vitro data workbook. Split its mixed source blocks into PK, PD, MIC, validation and benchmark inputs; check provenance, units, dose histories, experimental units and missing fields, and identify usable records and unresolved gaps before fitting.

evidence.quote: PMB_source_tables_by_species.xlsx is the single animal and in-vitro data workbook. Its sheets retain source-shaped tables and notes, not a ready-made modeling dataset:

1. Prepare the data. Split the mixed source blocks into PK, PD, MIC, validation, and benchmark inputs. Check provenance, units, dose histories, experimental units, and missing fields. Identify usable records and unresolved gaps before fitting.

rules.text: Preserve source identifiers, units, missing values and BLQ limits. Keep group means and digitized observations distinct from individual animals. Do not invent IDs, variability, exposure-response links or missing measurements.

evidence.quote: 1. Preserve evidence level. Keep source identifiers, units, missing values, and BLQ limits. Group means and digitized observations are not individual animals. Do not invent IDs, variability, exposure-response links, or missing measurements.

rules.text: Separate routes, formulations, analytes, total and unbound drug, and plasma, serum, whole-lung tissue, BAL and ELF. Record a justification for every conversion or physiological bridge. Never average conflicting binding sources; carry fu as a sensitivity parameter. Do not force unsupported pulmonary or multi-species models.

evidence.quote: 2. Keep biological quantities compatible. Separate routes, formulations, analytes, total versus unbound drug, and plasma, serum, whole-lung tissue, BAL, and ELF. Every conversion or physiological bridge requires a recorded justification. Binding sources conflict (mouse about 91% versus 97–99% bound; rat 80% versus 92–99%); never average them, and carry fu as a sensitivity parameter. Do not force unsupported pulmonary or multi-species models.

rules.text: Use mouse data for animal PK and eligible PD analysis, without treating separate panels as verified matched regimen records. Use rat data for systemic PK and supported pulmonary translation, without treating limited observations as establishing predictive validity.

evidence.quote: Use for animal PK and eligible PD analysis; separate panels are not verified matched regimen records.
Use for systemic PK and supported pulmonary translation; limited observations do not establish predictive validity.

rules.text: Select eligible systemic and, where supported, pulmonary PK models for mouse, rat and rabbit. Evaluate fit, parameter identifiability and held-out prediction where the design permits. Assess whether rabbit evidence identifies a model component or supports only exploratory constraints; preserve source discrepancies and document exclusion or exploratory use.

evidence.quote: Assess whether these support a model component or only exploratory constraints; preserve source discrepancies.

2. Fit animal PK. Select eligible systemic and, where supported, pulmonary PK models for mouse, rat and rabbit. Evaluate fit, parameter identifiability, and held-out prediction where the design permits. Use rabbit evidence only to the extent it identifies a model component; document exclusion or exploratory use.

rules.text: Use eligible K. pneumoniae time-kill data for PD and the surveillance MIC distribution for population-weighted attainment. The MIC distribution cannot replace matched strain MICs.

evidence.quote: Use eligible time-kill data for PD and the MIC distribution for population-weighted attainment; it cannot replace matched strain MICs.

rules.text: Do not use horse data to fit, select or scale models. After mouse, rat and rabbit scaling is frozen, predict horse profiles under the reported doses and compare them with the held-out figures as an intermediate large-body-weight translation check; record the result without retuning. Document that horse doses are mostly reported in IU without salt or base correction and that horse binding is unavailable.

evidence.quote: Do not use horse data to fit, select or scale models. After the mouse, rat and rabbit scaling is frozen, use them to test whether it predicts a large-body-weight species. Doses are mostly reported in IU without salt or base correction and no horse binding is available; document these limits.

Freeze the scaling, then predict horse profiles under the reported horse doses and compare them with the held-out horse figures as an intermediate translation check; record the result without retuning.

rules.text: Translate supported animal models using body size, protein binding and justified physiological relationships. Compare scaling with and without each species rather than assuming that more species is better. Predict human concentration-time profiles, AUC and Cmax with uncertainty under specified doses and routes, and freeze those predictions before opening human outcomes.

evidence.quote: Translate supported animal models using body size, protein binding, and justified physiological relationships. Compare scaling with and without each species rather than assuming more species is better.
Predict human concentration-time profiles, AUC, and Cmax with uncertainty under specified doses and routes, and freeze them before opening human outcomes.

rules.text: Keep the separately held human validation dataset and human reference tables unavailable until task 5, after the animal model, scaling and predictions are frozen. Human outcomes cannot tune the animal model or scaling.

evidence.quote: Human validation data are not in this package. The 40-patient dataset (230 concentration records, 268 dose events) and human reference tables are held in a separate file and released only at task 5, after the animal model, scaling and predictions are frozen.
Human outcomes cannot tune the animal model or scaling.

rules.text: Keep the scientific results in benchmark_reference.json hidden during selection. Published fitted parameters and model-derived results cannot set primary-analysis starting values, bounds, priors or rankings; reserve them for the final benchmark.

evidence.quote: benchmark_reference.json contains final-stage reference material, including published model-derived parameters and targets; keep its scientific results hidden during selection.
Published fitted parameters and model-derived results cannot set primary-analysis starting values, bounds, priors, or rankings. Keep them for the final benchmark.

rules.text: For eligible K. pneumoniae data, give fAUC/MIC, fCmax/MIC and fT>MIC equal eligibility and compare all three using both ordinary Emax and sigmoid Emax/Hill regression. Use the same matched response records, strain MICs, free-exposure basis, dosing histories, time windows and likelihood.

evidence.quote: For eligible K. pneumoniae data, compare fAUC/MIC, fCmax/MIC, and fT>MIC using ordinary Emax and sigmoid Emax/Hill regression.

Give all three indices equal eligibility and both regression families. Compare them on the same matched response records, strain MICs, free-exposure basis, dosing histories, time windows, and likelihood.

rules.text: Register the PK/PD index selection rule before fitting. Report R², AIC/BIC, stability and identifiability, counting the extra Hill parameter. Do not select by R² alone or force a winner; estimate supported exposure targets or report that the available data cannot determine a best index or target.

evidence.quote: Register the selection rule before fitting; report R², AIC/BIC, stability, and identifiability, counting the extra Hill parameter. Do not select by R² alone or force a winner.
Estimate supported exposure targets, or report that the available data cannot determine a best index or target.

rules.text: Keep stasis, 1-log kill and 2-log kill targets separate. Other pathogens cannot set K. pneumoniae targets.

evidence.quote: Keep stasis, 1-log kill, and 2-log kill targets separate; other pathogens cannot set K. pneumoniae targets.

rules.text: Freeze the model, validation criteria, PD targets and MIC input before their respective validation or dose-simulation steps. Preserve the original validation result if a later model is revised.

evidence.quote: Freeze the model, validation criteria, PD targets, and MIC input before their respective validation or dose-simulation steps. Preserve the original validation result if a later model is revised.

rules.text: Apply the frozen model to actual human dose histories. Compare predicted and observed plasma PK, assess ELF separately when compatible data exist, and report bias, precision, exposure agreement and predictive uncertainty against criteria fixed before validation.

evidence.quote: 5. Validate the human prediction. Apply the frozen model to actual human dose histories. Compare predicted and observed plasma PK; assess ELF separately when compatible data exist. Report bias, precision, exposure agreement, and predictive uncertainty against criteria fixed before validation.

rules.text: Only after PK validation and PD qualification, simulate a prespecified human population and dosing scenarios to estimate PTA at each MIC. Process the MIC distribution and report distribution-weighted attainment separately. If required inputs are missing, report why PTA is not estimable.

evidence.quote: After PK validation and PD qualification, simulate a prespecified human population and dosing scenarios to estimate the probability of target attainment (PTA) at each MIC. Process the MIC distribution and report distribution-weighted attainment separately.
if required inputs are missing, report why PTA is not estimable.

rules.text: Preserve MIC bins, units, counts/proportions, denominators and censored categories. Derive probabilities transparently and freeze the MIC distribution; never silently renormalize incomplete coverage. Distinguish per-MIC PTA from MIC-weighted attainment.

evidence.quote: Preserve MIC bins, units, counts/proportions, denominators, and censored categories. Derive probabilities transparently and freeze the MIC distribution; never silently renormalize incomplete coverage. Distinguish per-MIC PTA from MIC-weighted attainment.

rules.text: Include supported PK variability in PTA and propagate parameter, binding, PD-target and MIC uncertainty. Do not invent interindividual variability from group summaries.

evidence.quote: Include supported PK variability and propagate parameter, binding, PD-target, and MIC uncertainty; group summaries cannot supply invented interindividual variability.

rules.text: Include an exploratory efficacious-dose estimate where supported, uncertainty and the final published-result benchmark. Deliver PTA tables/curves, a feasibility conclusion and reproducible code.

evidence.quote: Include an exploratory efficacious-dose estimate where supported, uncertainty, and the final published-result benchmark. Deliver the PTA tables/curves, feasibility conclusion, and reproducible code;

rules.text: Limit conclusions to model feasibility rather than a clinical dosing recommendation or proof of generalizability. Do not treat a successful fit as predictive validation or human PK agreement as validation of antibacterial efficacy or safety. Preserve failures and data gaps.

evidence.quote: The primary outcome is model feasibility, not a clinical dosing recommendation or proof of generalizability.
A successful fit is not predictive validation; human PK agreement does not validate antibacterial efficacy or safety. Preserve failures and data gaps.

rules.text: Save transformations, assumptions, code, seeds and results.

evidence.quote: Save transformations, assumptions, code, seeds, and results, and obtain human review before fitting.

rules.text: Obtain human review before fitting. Apply this proposal as superseding earlier versions; prior approvals do not automatically carry forward.

evidence.quote: Save transformations, assumptions, code, seeds, and results, and obtain human review before fitting. This proposal supersedes earlier versions; prior approvals do not automatically carry forward.
